messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: multiple index question
parts:
Hi!

I wonder if the following is possible with the multi-index notation in Stan: I have a matrix of O lines with 3 columns, so

matrix[O, 3] obs;

Now, I have an integer index vector of length O

int idx[O];

and idx has elements 1, 2 or 3. The idx codes which element I want out of obs (per row of obs). So what I tried, but does not work is

vector[O] res;
res <- obs[1:O,idx];

Doing so creates a huge object on the RHS. So can this be done in Stan or do I have to loop?

Thanks.

Best,
Sebastian

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] multiple index question
parts:
Hi Sebastian,

Look at Ch 5 in the section on multiple indexing. I think you want an int idc[O, 2].


Daniel

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] multiple index question
parts:
That's a bug. I created an issue to explain what's going
on:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1960

For now, hopefully rep_array(0, 0) will work if you need
a size zero index.

For the second issue, only 1D arrays are allowed for
indexing. It'd make sense to generalize this into the future
for any dimensionality array as long as the number of index
dimensions is less than or equal to the container dimensions.

- Bob
